definitions.explanation: The period before a child enters compulsory education (elementary school in Japan, age 6). Used in education, childcare, and policy contexts.

examples.japanese: {就学前|しゅうがくまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{子|こ}ども。
{就学前|しゅうがくまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{重要視|じゅうようし}→重要視：16804_juuyoushi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。

{就学前|しゅうがくまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{段階|だんかい}→段階：04515_dankai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧、ひらがな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{読|よ}み{書|か}き→読み書き：21138_yomikaki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{習|なら}う→習う：00479_narau⟧{子|こ}ども⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: More children are learning to read and write hiragana at the preschool stage.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{就学|しゅうがく}→就学：06963_shuugaku⟧ (entering school; starting compulsory education) + ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ (before). In Japan, compulsory education begins at age 6 with ⟦{小学校|しょうがっこう}→小学校：01055_shougakkou⟧ (elementary school), so {就学前|しゅうがくまえ} refers to children under 6.

Used as a no-adjective modifier: {就学前|しゅうがくまえ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧ (preschool children).

The ⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧ suffix pattern is productive for time expressions: {出発前|しゅっぱつまえ} (before departure), {結婚前|けっこんまえ} (before marriage).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {就学前|しゅうがくまえ}{教育|きょういく}: preschool education
- {就学前|しゅうがくまえ}⟦{児童|じどう}→児童：03340_jidou⟧: preschool-age children
- {就学前|しゅうがくまえ}⟦{健康|けんこう}{診断|しんだん}→健康診断：05979_kenkoushindan⟧: pre-enrollment health checkup

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {未就学|みしゅうがく}: not yet enrolled in school — more formal, used in official documents
- ⟦{幼児|ようじ}→幼児：12478_youji⟧: young child; toddler — refers to the age group (roughly 1-6) rather than the school status
- {学齢|がくれい}: school age — the age at which compulsory education begins
